title: Point Feature Descriptor via Directional Partition of Unity on Maps
summary: We develop a functional-analytic framework for smooth directional point descriptors in GPS-free map-based localization. Given a query point $\mathbf{p}$ in a map $\mathcal{M} \subset \mathbb{R}^d$, the descriptor integrates an environment signal against a partition-of-unity weight family built from a softmax kernel, yielding a $\mathcal{C}^\infty$ alternative to hard angular binning.
